title: Past the handoff threshold the lead cannot start new lanes or agents
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (docs/program/standards-enforcement.md). Evidence: KRN-13 and lead-rules.md:38: above 100k context the lead must not start a new unrelated task or a long detached run; src/context/gauge.ts only advises.
Files: src/context/gauge.ts, scripts/claude/*, test/context/gauge.test.ts
Outcome: Past the handoff threshold the PreToolUse hook refuses krn lane start and a new Agent launch for the lead (draining running lanes stays allowed) and names delivery-handoff as the next step.
Proof: node --test on the touched test: a launch above the threshold is refused, one below and a SendMessage to a running lane are allowed.
